models.name: Muse Spark Open
models.license: Meta Muse Model License (free download; MaaS providers over $20M revenue need a separate agreement)
models.vram_min: 1TB unified across two machines (Meta's Mac recipe: 2x M5 Ultra Mac Studio at 512GB each)

engines.hardware: 2x M5 Ultra Mac Studio, 512GB each, Thunderbolt 5 + RDMA, one full copy of the compressed model per machine (Apple-measured)
engines.quant: 4-bit compressed weights, about 493GB; 1M-token context; Meta's guide also allows four 256GB Mac Studios

models.why: Meta's 816B/42B-active open-weight model needs two 512GB M5 Ultra Mac Studios just to hold its ~493GB 4-bit weights, and Apple measured about 25 generated tok/s on that two-machine cluster (four Mac Studios reached >36 tok/s) — desk-local only at workstation-cluster scale.
